summary.text: Dalton Banks is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 26, serving since January 2023, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Dalton Banks was born in Powell, Wyoming, and earned a degree in public administration from the University of Wyoming in 2020.
Banks assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 2, 2023, succeeding Jamie Flitner.

For 2025-2026, Banks's committee assignments include the House Agriculture, State and Public Lands and Water Resources Committee, the House Transportation, Highways and Military Affairs Committee and the Select Water Committee.
